name: surreal-pelican-woman
image_purpose: Conceptual image post and surreal transformation prompt

prompt.project_info: Create a surreal coastal editorial image based on the supplied reference, presenting an approved adult woman as the visual replacement for a pelican while retaining the unusual prompt-card presentation.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with natural features and windblown light-brown hair, seated on a weathered coastal post and wearing a secure long-sleeved cobalt-blue dress. Keep her pose calm and slightly turned toward the sea.
prompt.composition_elements: Rocky shoreline, calm blue water, distant headland, weathered wooden post, and a large white pinned prompt card at right. The card may contain the provided conceptual text as legible typography; keep it clean and intentionally placed.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overcast daylight, gentle coastal haze, natural wind movement in hair and dress, muted blue-green palette with the blue dress as the main color accent.
prompt.technical_specs: Wide horizontal editorial composition, realistic environmental detail, natural skin texture, balanced negative space for the prompt card, crisp but lightly documentary finish.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A whimsical surreal coastal editorial photograph of one approved adult woman with natural features and windblown light-brown hair, seated calmly on a weathered wooden post above a rocky shoreline, wearing a secure long-sleeved cobalt-blue dress. Calm blue water, distant headland, soft overcast daylight, coastal haze, natural wind movement, muted blue-green palette, and a large clean white pinned prompt card at the right with intentional legible conceptual typography about a pelican being replaced by a woman. Wide horizontal composition, realistic texture, storybook surrealism, documentary finish.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, unsafe perch, distorted anatomy, malformed hands, unreadable typography, random text, watermark, random logos, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, low resolution, blur

assets.name: surreal-pelican-woman.jpg
assets.usage: Use for coastal setting, woman in blue dress, weathered post, prompt card placement, and overall surreal editorial composition.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve the approved adult subject, coastal environment, blue dress, post, prompt card placement, and overcast mood consistently. The reference is replaceable: another approved adult subject, coastal location, dress color, or card wording may be substituted while retaining the surreal transformation concept. Explicitly define any replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent them.
